_comment: Finds the far end of the imitation dose curve. At 47x (weight 64) the common-profile share already matches the flown tracks (3.3% vs 3.2%) and bank skill is still climbing steeply (+0.144 from 11.8x), so the curve has no visible turn yet and freezing a recipe means knowing which side of it we are on. Weight 256 = 188x the position term on the converged KRDU baseline calibration (w = 1.36 is 1x). Seed 1337, matching the rest of the ladder. Expect one of: a turn (structure metrics stop improving or accuracy degrades), or a collapse into a pure schedule-fitter that ignores position -- both are informative, and the ADE/FDE columns plus the paired test against 47x tell them apart.
